testsuite global:
    teardown:
        exit

testcase default:
    $ _test.transition_timeout = 0.05
    $ _test.timeout = 20.0
    click "Start"
    pause 1.0
    advance until screen "choice"
    click "Go down River"
    advance until screen "the_end"
    click "Back to main menu"
    click "Preferences"
    click "Hrvatski"
    pause 0.5
    assert eval renpy.get_screen("preferences") is not None
    click "Povratak"
    click "Započni"
    pause 1.0
    advance until screen "choice"
    click "Idi Pekarskom"
    advance until screen "the_end"
    assert screen "the_end"
